basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Seattle who recently got into gaming through my husband's influence. Aside from dabbling in Genshin Impact, I enjoy playing casual mobile games and occasionally join my husband in his gaming marathons. When I'm not working, I love exploring the local coffee scene and hiking the beautiful trails around the Pacific Northwest. I'm usually online during the evenings and weekends. Married to a fellow gamer, but I consider myself more of a casual player.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in visual arts and design, having studied graphic design in college. My introduction to gaming is relatively recent, sparked by my husband's enthusiasm for video games. I've been learning through firsthand experience and some online tutorials, especially when it comes to Genshin Impact and other games he recommends.
